subject: MAP: HealthCorps evaluation runway & acceptance checklist
messages:
From: Alyssa Turner <alyssa@healthcorps.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-06-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff & acceptance criteria (HealthCorps)

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Procurement asked us to capture a short mutual action plan so leadership can sign off on the pilot window and acceptance criteria. Can you send a draft MAP that includes:
- explicit success metrics we can use to measure token-level latency and relevance during the 30-day pilot
- the exit gates if performance falls below threshold
- what evidence we should hand over for the procurement review

If you can share a one-sheet or spreadsheet by EOD Monday that has responsibilities and dates, we can circulate it to our CTO and procurement.

Best,
Alyssa
Head of Integrations, HealthCorps
[Attachment: None]
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alyssa Turner <alyssa@healthcorps.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-06-04T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: RE: MAP kickoff & acceptance criteria (HealthCorps)

Alyssa —

Appreciate the clarity. Attached is a first-pass MAP spreadsheet (HealthCorps_MAP_v1.xlsx) and a short smoke-test checklist (smoke_test_scripts_v2.md). High-level summary below so your leadership can see the runway at a glance:

Mutual Action Plan (summary):
- Pilot window: 2028-06-10 -> 2028-07-09 (30 days)
- Primary goals: 95th percentile generation latency < 350ms for typical 256-token prompts; semantic relevance uplift measured by A/B on clinician prompts >= +12% precision@3 compared to baseline
- Exit gates (immediate): any sustained 95th percentile latency > 600ms for 2 consecutive days OR precision@3 delta < -5% vs baseline after 7 days of tuning
- Acceptance evidence bundle: latency charts (per route), 1K sampled prompts and model outputs with annotation, load test report, signed mutual action signoff
- Roles & owners: HealthCorps provides test prompt corpus and annotation team (Alyssa); Redwood provides dedicated pilot capacity + runbook (Grace) and QA smoke scripts (Ben)

Next steps we propose:
1) You confirm test prompt set and annotation owner by 2028-06-06
2) Redwood provisions pilot pool and shares test harness by 2028-06-08
3) Dry run & smoke tests 2028-06-09
4) Pilot go-live 2028-06-10 -> daily sampling and weekly checkpoints
5) Final acceptance review and signoff by 2028-07-10

Quick ask: can you confirm whether HealthCorps needs an SOC-2 addendum in the procurement package? If yes, Marissa will include the compliance packet.

Thanks — attaching files now.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: HealthCorps_MAP_v1.xlsx (xlsx, 42KB)]
[Attachment: smoke_test_scripts_v2.md (md, 6KB)]
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-06-04T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: quick review of MAP draft for HealthCorps

Grace —

Skimmed the MAP. A couple of notes before we send the formal one-sheet to Alyssa/CTO:
- Add explicit sampling cadence in acceptance evidence: daily 100-sample random seed and weekly stratified review of edge-case prompts (e.g., long clinical notes, truncated ICD codes)
- For the relevance metric, define the annotation rubric (precision@3 is fine but call out binary vs graded labels)
- Contingency: if we hit the latency exit gate, propose a 7-day remediation twitch where Redwood will apply quantization/auto-batching adjustments; if unresolved, Tier-2 escalation to architecture + option to revert to a fall-back model at reduced cost.

I'll add a short appendix to the MAP spreadsheet with the remediation path. Marissa — can you confirm SOC-2 addendum status?

Ben
Director, Solutions Engineering
[Attachment: none]
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-06-04T12:10:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Internal: quick review of MAP draft for HealthCorps

Ben / Grace —

We have a SOC 2 Type II artifact package (summary and evidence links) we can include; procurement usually asks for the one-page attestation + redacted auditor report. I'll prepare the packet and drop a Drive link in the MAP spreadsheet.

Also added: a short checklist of acceptance tests derived from Ben's notes (included below in the MAP appendix). Will send updated spreadsheet by EOD.

Marissa Cole
Senior Security & Compliance Liaison, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: none]
From: Alyssa Turner <alyssa@healthcorps.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: HealthCorps Procurement <procurement@healthcorps.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-06-07T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: RE: MAP kickoff & acceptance criteria (HealthCorps)

Grace —

This looks great and addresses the procurement asks. A few clarifications from the CTO:
- On relevance measurement: we'll use binary annotation for precision@3 for the first runway, with an option to switch to graded later.
- For the latency remediation window, 7 days is acceptable. Please include a short rollback plan that outlines the expected customer impact and the fall-back model characteristics.

Procurement confirms they will need the SOC-2 summary in the packet — Marissa, please include that when you send the updated MAP.

We approve the proposed pilot window and will provide the initial 1K prompt corpus and annotation team by 2028-06-06 as requested. Looking forward to the dry run on the 9th.

Thanks,
Alyssa Turner
Head of Integrations, HealthCorps
[Attachment: none]
